component.name: Orbit Tape
component.summary: Native crypto charting desk for the COSMIC desktop

description.p: Orbit Tape is a COSMIC-focused fork of Flowsurface, a native desktop charting app for crypto markets. It streams trades and order books straight from the exchanges and draws them as heatmaps, footprint and candlestick charts, time and sales, and a DOM ladder.

ul.li: Order book heatmap, candlestick footprint and volume profile charts
Follows the COSMIC theme, including light and dark mode
Binance, Bybit, Hyperliquid, OKX and MEXC market data

screenshot.caption: Candlestick, heatmap and order flow panes

description.p: Saved alerts on OKX spot pairs, and WATCH alerts that wait at the zone edge when price is already inside the zone.
An MCP server for Claude, saved alerts with a background watcher and ntfy phone push, a daily trading routine report, and notices when an installed indicator is older than the shipped one.
Theme color fields show their resolved hex value, and the Roman Setup Bull breaker defaults to its original blue.
Faster Key Levels on long histories, a wider Settings panel and new screenshots.
Key Levels, Bull Market Support Band and SMA x4 indicators; accent and indicator colors set with a picker or hex; a headless indicator scan with an optional timer; live reload of indicator files.
Drawing, indicator and series colors follow the COSMIC theme palette while the app follows COSMIC.
Right-click price alerts on the chart, and chart menu entries to remove all alerts, drawings, indicators or studies.
First Orbit Tape release: Linux and COSMIC only, new name and icon, indicator alerts, COSMIC theme and frosted glass support.
